instruction: Working Studio redesign: original layered illustrations and reconstructed interfaces throughout. Preserve exact script and measured narration. Proposed storyboard only; no human approval inferred.

design.meaning: You could start a DeepSeek V4.1 Flash business without building an app. Here's a service you can build, and how to pitch it to a business owner.
design.metaphor: A real working salon is the customer, not a software icon.
design.layout: Large two-line title over a full-width illustrated salon.

shots.framing: Large two-line title over a full-width illustrated salon.
shots.subject: Expressive owner and reception desk.
shots.action: Open on the complete salon; inquiries enter from both sides, then the service title lands. Camera follows the owner, not a floating symbol.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: Start with a salon. Ask the owner which booking questions they keep answering, and where replies get stuck.
design.metaphor: The reception counter becomes the pressure point for unanswered questions.
design.focalPoint: Owner between two approaching inquiry tickets.
design.layout: Environment-first salon fills the upper frame; the problem statement lands underneath.
design.continuityReason: The same workplace makes the problem/payoff connection explicit.

shots.framing: Environment-first salon fills the upper frame; the problem statement lands underneath.
shots.subject: Owner between two approaching inquiry tickets.
shots.action: Match the opening room. Punch into the owner as inquiry tickets arrive; hold the visibly overwhelmed expression. No invented counts or lost revenue.
shots.continuity: Retain the same salon and owner to introduce the problem.

design.meaning: Build a demo around those questions, using made-up inquiries and the owner's approved FAQ.
design.metaphor: An overhead research desk separates question samples from an owner-approved reference binder.
design.focalPoint: Physical FAQ binder and owner sign-off.
design.layout: Overhead diagonal stationery composition with large editable corner labels.

shots.framing: Overhead diagonal stationery composition with large editable corner labels.
shots.subject: Physical FAQ binder and owner sign-off.
shots.action: Match-cut an inquiry ticket onto the research desk. Reveal reference pages, compare samples, then stamp owner approval. Fabricated question content stays reviewer metadata.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: A customer submits a form. Their question lands in Google Sheets, and n8n picks up the new row.
design.metaphor: A submitted inquiry becomes a highlighted row, then a trigger activates the HTTP request.
design.focalPoint: Highlighted Google Sheets row and n8n trigger.
design.layout: Tall stacked software cutaway with actual operation names.

shots.framing: Tall stacked software cutaway with actual operation names.
shots.subject: Highlighted Google Sheets row and n8n trigger.
shots.action: Reveal the intake form, insert one row, carry its packet into Google Sheets Trigger and activate HTTP Request. Stage UI labels instead of shrinking them.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: It sends the question and FAQ to DeepSeek. Use the model name deepseek-flash, and request a category and reply draft as JSON: structured fields your workflow can read.
design.metaphor: A processor cutaway combines the inquiry and reference rather than a magical all-knowing chatbot.
design.focalPoint: Isometric processor between two inputs and a structured draft.
design.layout: Dark cinematic stage with input rails, raised processor and output drawer.

shots.framing: Dark cinematic stage with input rails, raised processor and output drawer.
shots.subject: Isometric processor between two inputs and a structured draft.
shots.action: Two input packets travel to the processor. Its top opens; category and reply_draft reveal in the output drawer. Punch on the field structure after both inputs arrive.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: Check those fields, update the sheet, and notify the owner. They check the facts, edit, and approve before sending. Missing information goes back to them, too.
design.metaphor: A physical hand interrupts automation at the review desk.
design.focalPoint: Human hand beside review controls and unresolved tray.
design.layout: Close review monitor above; the human decision statement anchors the lower third.

shots.framing: Close review monitor above; the human decision statement anchors the lower third.
shots.subject: Human hand beside review controls and unresolved tray.
shots.action: Validate fields and update the row, notify the owner, highlight their edit, then require their approval. The unresolved tray is routed back to the owner. No automatic send.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: Test a booking question and one the FAQ cannot answer.
design.metaphor: Two test benches make the success path and uncertainty path equally visible.
design.focalPoint: Booking test on one side and owner escalation on the other.
design.layout: Full-height paired test lanes; one check and one unresolved question.

shots.framing: Full-height paired test lanes; one check and one unresolved question.
shots.subject: Booking test on one side and owner escalation on the other.
shots.action: Run the booking case first; its calendar resolves to a draft. Run the unknown case second; its information gap routes to the owner. Never show a fabricated pass rate.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: Then show the owner that workflow. Ask whether it fits their process, and offer setup, testing, and a handover, with optional maintenance.
design.metaphor: A service leaves a working demonstration, test evidence and documented handover on a real desk.
design.focalPoint: Open laptop, checked test cards and reference binder.
design.layout: Illustrated meeting leads; an offer statement sits beneath the tangible delivery kit.

shots.framing: Illustrated meeting leads; an offer statement sits beneath the tangible delivery kit.
shots.subject: Open laptop, checked test cards and reference binder.
shots.action: Show the laptop demonstration to the owner; test cards and handover binder assemble around it. Maintenance remains an optional agreement, with no sale or customer result implied.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: Agree who pays the API and hosting bills. DeepSeek charges by usage.
design.metaphor: Separate metered model usage from hosting, then put responsibility into the agreement.
design.focalPoint: Usage meter, server stack and signed responsibility sheet.
design.layout: Instruments and agreement lead the composition; cost responsibility concludes below.

shots.framing: Instruments and agreement lead the composition; cost responsibility concludes below.
shots.subject: Usage meter, server stack and signed responsibility sheet.
shots.action: The API meter responds to usage while hosting stays a separate obligation. End on responsibility agreement. Do not invent rates, costs, savings or earnings.
shots.continuity: Carry the inquiry motif into a distinct explanatory composition.

design.meaning: You're selling a working inquiry process, with the owner in control of every reply.
design.metaphor: Return to the same workplace with a calm owner and a visible review process.
design.focalPoint: The same owner now working with their review console.
design.layout: Opening environment returns, calmer silhouette and strong final statement.
design.continuityReason: The same workplace makes the problem/payoff connection explicit.

shots.purpose: Bring control back to the salon
shots.framing: Opening environment returns, calmer silhouette and strong final statement.
shots.subject: The same owner now working with their review console.
shots.action: Match back into the original salon. Replace inquiry pressure with a calm owner examining a draft. End on the explicit owner decision boundary, not a fabricated business result.
shots.continuity: Return to the same salon to connect service and customer.
